glosses: model (a successful example to be copied)
model (a representation of a physical object in miniature)
model (a simplified representation used to explain the workings of a system or event)

examples.text: Tanto Tom como Mary trabajan de modelos.
examples.en: Both Tom and Mary work as models.
I'm an actress, not a model.

examples.text: Creo que hoy en día las modelos son demasiado delgadas.
examples.en: I think fashion models today are too thin.
